offers.description:
We are looking for a creative Developer, inspired by innovation and creative thinking.

Signifly is an award-winning agency, behind some of the Danes’ favourite apps and digital experiences. 

We are looking for a Creative Developer with experience in shipping with AI and strong front-end skills to join our Creative Tech team in Copenhagen. You will be an essential part of developing new digital concepts together with our clients and colleagues, both here in Vesterbro and across our offices in London, Montreal and Toronto.

Things that matter: TypeScript, Next.js, and React, an eye for detail, love good design and building products that matter to real people. 

About Signifly

Signifly is one of the fastest growing innovation agencies in Denmark. Our team has won several awards for our innovative approach to digital products and user experiences. We are an ambitious team that is constantly pushing the limits of our work and our own capabilities.

We collaborate with a broad range of clients from all industries to create new and innovative digital products and business models. We are a team of developers, designers, film makers and digital strategists, and we believe that creativity, entrepreneurship and a diverse mix of top-notch skills can drive the innovation and change that will help shape a better tomorrow.

Agentic engineering – with craft at the core

We’re operating in a time of agentic engineering. AI agents are changing how software gets built, and we embrace that: we use agentic tools to ship faster and build AI-powered features into client products.

At the same time, we know that reaching the quality we aim for means sticking to the fundamentals of good software development. Agents amplify good engineering, they don’t replace it. We’re looking for someone with strong fundamentals in architecture, code quality and judgment, who can put these new tools to work without compromising on craft.

Key tasks

  • Build creative digital products and services, with a heavy focus on developing smooth, best-in-class front-end, interactions and user experience.

  • Turn design into performant, accessible and maintainable solutions in TypeScript and Next.js

  • Use agentic tools in your day-to-day development and help build AI-powered features into our clients’ products

  • Stay up to date with new trends and technologies and share your knowledge, so the team can deliver exciting and innovative solutions

  • Support with tech knowledge and skills across Signifly’s different teams

Are you a strategist who can go from a client's business problem to a brand idea to a creative brief without missing a beat? Read on.

Our Montréal strategy team is looking for a Senior Strategist with strong roots in creative work and the range to move between brand, communication and business challenges. One week you're writing a campaign brief. The next you're building a brand platform or helping a client rethink how they go to market.

You're both a leader and a doer. We care more about your thinking and your work than your current title.

What you'll do

  • Strategy work across a mix of projects: creative campaigns, brand development, digital experiences and business or go-to-market challenges.

  • Find the insight that unlocks the work, through research, client immersion, cultural observation and a good dose of curiosity.

  • Write creative briefs that inspire, and stay close to the creative team through concepting and production to keep the idea sharp and on strategy.

  • Build brand platforms: positioning, purpose, personality, messaging and storytelling.

  • Help clients connect brand ambition to business goals, whether that means a launch plan, a new offering or a customer experience strategy.

  • Present to clients and win them over. Tell the story behind the work in a way that makes the room lean in.

  • Look past the initial scope to spot new growth and innovation opportunities for every client.

What you bring

  • 6+ years in strategy (creative, brand or communications) at an agency, with work you can walk us through where your thinking visibly shaped the outcome.

  • Real fluency in the creative process. You know how to work with creative directors, designers, copywriters and filmmakers, and you earn their trust.

  • Solid brand strategy experience, from positioning and brand platforms to identity projects.

  • Enough business sense to hold your own with a CMO or CEO, and an understanding of how brand and creative decisions drive commercial results.

  • A proper pencil-chewer's pen. You write clearly and persuasively, and you can say a lot in very few words.

  • The ability to go from big-picture brand dreams to concrete business objectives, and back, in the same meeting.

  • Comfort structuring a strategy on your own, from blank page to final deck.

  • The ability to read a room, understand what clients really need, and help sell the work.

  • Energy in an environment that changes constantly. No two projects look the same here.

  • Fluent written and spoken English and French.

Please expect no less from us

The most important thing we offer is an inspiring and ambitious work environment, with an emphasis on learning and developing, both personally and as a team.

We believe the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. We create a work environment with plenty of room for being ambitious within your own area of expertise, or to take part in shaping our team, culture, and product offerings.

But, of course, we can also tempt you with:

  • Group insurance plan (partially paid), including extended health, travel, dental etc., for you and your family

  • Group Pension Plan (WealthSimple)

    Catered (GREAT) lunch

  • Coffee, tea, soft drinks, and snacks, anytime

  • Hybrid work and flexible working hours

  • Beautiful office space, centrally located in Old Montréal

  • Voluntary sports activities

  • Inspiration-trips to events, meet-ups, and conferences

  • Career progress based on merits rather than seniority

And if you think something is missing, just let us know. After all, we are trying to create the best possible place to work!

About Signifly

At Signifly, we work in collaboration with a broad range of clients from all industries, to create new and innovative brands, digital products and business models.

We are a team of strategists, designers, filmmakers, developers, and growth marketers who believe that creativity, entrepreneurship, passion and a diverse mix of top-notch skills can drive the kind of change to shape a better and more sustainable tomorrow.

Check out our work at Signifly.com

offers.description:
We are looking for a Senior Consultant, Digital Project manager

Hi there,

You know how to run projects.

But more importantly, you know when to challenge them.

Do you enjoy working in an agency with ambitious clients who expect more than “on time and on budget”? Do you like turning messy ideas into sharp directions, and doing it with a team that actually enjoys the process?

Then you’ll probably like it here.

Our Montreal team is looking for a Senior Digital Project Manager to join our client team.

In this role, you don’t just manage projects, you shape them. From the very first conversation, you help define the right approach, the right scope, and sometimes tell clients what they actually need, not just what they asked for.

You’ll work with designers, developers, strategists, and growth specialists across Montreal, Copenhagen, London, and Toronto. Different time zones, different perspectives, same goal: build digital brands and experiences to delight people and drive business.

At Signifly, we challenge the status quo across brand, digital, and business. Not because it sounds good, but because it leads to better work. We take what we do seriously, but not ourselves.

If you’re looking for a role where you just execute tickets, this is not it.

If you like ownership, clarity, momentum, and a team that brings both ambition and good energy, you’ll fit right in.

We’re looking for someone who combines strong project management skills with a deep understanding of digital agency environments and digital projects, and who can confidently mobilize both teams and clients around the work.

What you’ll own

  • Own the early phase of client engagements, from first conversation to defining the right approach and scope, yes, you’re the one asking the questions no one else thought of

  • Help shape proposals that actually make sense, for the client, for the team, and for reality

  • Lead digital projects (website, applications, digital marketing) end-to-end: scope, budget, timelines, delivery, and keeping everyone sane along the way

  • Translate business goals and client needs into clear product direction, turning “we need something cool” into something that actually works

  • Own requirement gathering and structuring, bringing clarity to complex needs and turning them into actionable plans

  • Build and manage well-structured backlogs, with clear priorities, logic, and purpose, no chaos, no guesswork

  • Align designers, developers, strategists, and marketers around shared goals, even when opinions get strong

  • Spot risks early, solve problems fast, keep momentum high, before things become “a situation”

  • Build strong client relationships grounded in trust, honesty, and not just saying yes to everything

  • Continuously improve how we work, because “we’ve always done it this way” is not your thing

Your skills & expertise

  • Strong foundation in project management, you know your frameworks, but you’re not a slave to them

  • Experience in business requirement gathering and translating needs into structured plans, user stories, and backlogs

  • Ability to bring clarity to ambiguity, structuring complex ideas into actionable product direction

  • Solid understanding of digital: branding, web, UX, and growth, you get how it all connects

  • Strategic mindset, you don’t just execute, you question, challenge, and improve

  • Confidence in client conversations, including scope, budget, and value, you can have the conversations others avoid

  • Ability to lead and challenge cross-functional teams to reach stronger outcomes, not just polite alignment

  • Strong understanding of AI tools, and more importantly, when and how they actually make sense to use

Who you are

  • Positive energy and strong team spirit, people like working with you, it matters

  • Structured and proactive, you bring clarity where others see complexity

  • High ownership and drive, you don’t wait to be told, you move things forward

  • You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity and turning it into direction

  • You bring momentum, raise the bar, and don’t settle for average work, even when it would be easier

  • Strong communicator in English and French, clear, direct, and easy to understand, even on a Monday morning

Please expect from us

The most important thing that we offer is an inspiring and ambitious work environment, with an emphasis on learning and development, both personally and as a team. We have an informal organization with minimal hierarchy, where there is plenty of room for being ambitious within your own area of expertise, as well as taking part in shaping our team, culture and product offering.

Also, make sure to check out our Instagram for the latest and greatest ;)

But of course, we can also tempt you with:

  • Yearly one-week team trip with both social and professional focus (paid)

  • Healthy fresh catered lunch (3 days a week) with vegetarian options (subsidized)

  • Coffee, tea, soft drinks, snacks, etc. day and night

  • Beautiful office space with 24/7 access, centrally located in Montreal

  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and performance

  • Great Group Insurance Plan including extended health and dental

  • Group Pension Plan

  • Culture of Learning & Development

  • Monthly Social & team events

  • Career progress based on merits rather than seniority

And if you think something is missing, just let us know. We can probably work together to add it. After all, we are trying to create the best possible place to work!

About Signifly

At Signifly, we work in close collaboration with a broad range of clients from all industries, to create new and innovative digital products and business models. We are a team of developers, designers, filmmakers, growth marketers, and digital strategists. We believe that creativity, entrepreneurship and a diverse mix of top-notch skills can drive the innovation and change that will help shape a better and more sustainable tomorrow.

We have an informal organization with minimal hierarchy, where there is plenty of room for being ambitious within your own area of expertise, as well as taking part in shaping our team, culture, and product offering.

But, of course, we can also tempt you with:

  • Yearly one-week team trip with both social and professional focuses (paid) - in 2023 we went to Portugal.

  • Fresh catered lunch of mostly organic produce and with vegetarian options

  • Coffee, tea, soft drinks, snacks, etc. day and night - and wine, beer and drinks on Fridays

  • Beautiful office space with emphasis noise reduction, centrally located in Vesterbro

  • Paid equipment of high quality - you choose what you prefer

  • In-office massage service

  • Inspiration-trips to events, meet-ups, and conferences

  • Company paid pension and health insurance

  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and performance

  • Career progress based on merits rather than seniority

  • Opportunity to work-exchange with our office in Montreal, London and Toronto

And if you think something is missing, just let us know. We can probably work together to add it. After all, we are trying to create the best possible place to work!

Practical information

  • Position: Full-time, 40 hours per week

  • Location: Signifly, Vesterbrogade 46, 1st floor, Copenhagen V

  • Language: Danish

  • Tech stack: TypeScript, Next.js, React, and Tailwind

Please submit your CV or online profile (LinkedIn or GitHub) – and feel free to include links to projects you’re proud of. Then we will be in touch!
offers.description:
A Tech & Business Lead inspired by innovation… just as curious about business as about code.

Can you take a digital product all the way from the first business need to a launched platform, website or eCommerce setup, and describe, plan, document and facilitate the process along the way? Then we'd love to hear from you!!!

We are looking for someone who thrives in the technical process with our developers and loves diving into the architecture and business decisions that shape today’s digital products. BUT also a person who loves working closely with designers, strategists and creatives, to create the best possible outcome for users out there. So what does that mean?

Things that matter: Strong technical skills, real curiosity about business and innovation, a nose for the smart solution and a love for building products that matter to real people.

About Signifly

Signifly is one of the fastest growing innovation agencies in Denmark. Our team has won several awards for our innovative approach to digital products and user experiences. We are an ambitious team that is constantly pushing the limits of our work and our own capabilities. We collaborate with a broad range of clients from all industries to create new and innovative digital products and business models. We are a team of developers, designers, film makers and digital strategists, and we believe that creativity, entrepreneurship and a diverse mix of top-notch skills can drive the innovation and change that will help shape a better tomorrow.

Agentic engineering – with craft at the core

We're operating in a time of agentic engineering. AI agents are changing how software gets built, and we embrace that: we use agentic tools to ship faster and build AI-powered features into client products.

At the same time, we know that great solutions still start with the fundamentals. Agents amplify good engineering, they don't replace it. As our Tech & Business Lead, you help decide where AI makes a solution better, and where good old craft is still the way to go.

Key tasks

  • Turn business needs into clear technical solutions, from the first idea to the launched product

  • Describe, plan and facilitate the development process together with designers, strategists and developers

  • Be hands-on and run the process end-to-end on smaller projects

  • Own the technical deliverable on larger projects and align with the innovation lead on business and project goals

  • Validate solutions early, so we build the right thing in the right way

  • Bring AI and agentic tools into our projects where they create real value

Bienvenue chez Signifly
Rêvez-vous de travailler pour une agence digitale à service complet, où les collègues peuvent devenir des amis et où vous pouvez réaliser vos ambitions professionnelles tout en créant des produits et des solutions numériques pour les marques les plus cool ? Alors, vous êtes au bon endroit !

En tant qu'équipe, nous avons produit une croissance annuelle à deux chiffres et reçu de nombreux prix au cours des dernières années. Cependant, nous avons encore de nombreux nouveaux objectifs et ambitions. Nous recherchons de nouveaux collègues à Londres, Montréal et Copenhague, alors n'hésitez pas à nous contacter.

Nos équipes:

Responsable de l'Innovation - Pouvez-vous faciliter une collaboration créative et inspirante avec des clients ambitieux tout en dirigeant une équipe dynamique de spécialistes numériques pour mener à bien les projets ? Vous serez un point de contact important pour nos clients, et avec un esprit stratégique, vos excellentes compétences en communication et en structuration, vous les guiderez tout au long de notre cycle de projet du début à la fin. Vous gérerez des équipes de projet géographiquement dispersées avec des spécialistes de tous les bureaux, et vous jouerez un rôle crucial dans l'établissement de projets évolutifs pour réussir avec les projets - tant au niveau local qu'international.

Stratège - En rejoignant notre équipe de stratégie en pleine croissance, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la définition et la redéfinition des marques de demain en travaillant avec à la fois des leaders du marché et des challengers dans une large gamme d'industries. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec notre équipe de design, créative et de responsables de l'innovation, comblant le fossé entre des solutions numériques puissantes et des marques inspirantes avec lesquelles les gens veulent interagir. Cela pourrait-il être votre rôle ?

  • Préparer et animer des ateliers stratégiques avec des dirigeants et être capable de comprendre les défis commerciaux essentiels et de les traduire en problèmes humains.

  • Concevoir et mener des recherches pour obtenir une compréhension plus approfondie de l'audience, de l'entreprise, de la culture et du paysage concurrentiel.

  • Développer des stratégies de marque et de communication, des plateformes, des messages et des identités rhétoriques permettant aux clients de gérer une entreprise plus axée sur la marque.

  • Élaborer des stratégies créatives et des briefs et travailler en étroite collaboration avec notre équipe créative et de design sur le développement de concepts visuels et créatifs.

  • Conseiller les clients sur la stratégie commerciale et CX et ses implications pour la marque et le contenu.

  • Prendre la tête des relations clients importantes et permettre des partenariats à long terme réussis en collaboration étroite avec nos Consultants et Responsables de l'Innovation.


Consultant - Vous vous associerez à nos équipes spécialisées et à nos Responsables de l'Innovation pour garder nos clients satisfaits, établir et maintenir des partenariats commerciaux authentiques, gérer les demandes quotidiennes des clients et créer de manière proactive des stratégies numériques à long terme pour nos clients.

Ce rôle a un fort accent commercial et est responsable de la construction d'un pipeline stratégique de nouveaux projets et de projets existants. Votre objectif sera de garantir que tout le travail fourni soit gagnant-gagnant pour le client et pour Signifly. Nous parlons de valeur créée, de gestion intelligente des budgets, de satisfaction globale et d'impact stratégique à long terme.


Développeurs (frontend & fullstack) - Notre équipe de développeurs est un élément clé dans le développement de nouveaux concepts. En tant que membre de notre équipe Creative Tech, vous serez une partie essentielle du développement de nouveaux concepts numériques avec nos clients et l'équipe autour de vous. Étant une agence, nous travaillons avec une gamme de clients, généralement dans des sprints concentrés où nous construisons de nouveaux produits pour eux ou améliorons des produits que nous avons précédemment développés avec eux. Donc, si vous êtes un expert en React, Vue.js ou un autre framework JavaScript similaire, et que vous avez un intérêt naturel pour le développement de vous-même, de votre équipe et de vos clients avec nous, nous espérons avoir de vos nouvelles. Encore mieux si vous aimez le bon design, avez un œil pour les détails et ne craignez pas les défis, nous espérons vraiment avoir de vos nouvelles.


Et vous pourriez également venir d'un chemin complètement différent - vous êtes toujours le bienvenu si vous avez un esprit entrepreneurial, êtes un doer et pourriez être un conseiller numérique fantastique.


Si vous voyez un match entre vos compétences et les ambitions que nous décrivons, vous pouvez facilement postuler en soumettant votre CV et une brève motivation, et répondre à quelques questions telles que


Ce que vous pouvez attendre de nous:

La chose la plus importante que nous offrons est un environnement de travail inspirant et ambitieux, avec un accent sur l'apprentissage et le développement, à la fois personnel et en équipe. Nous avons une organisation informelle avec une hiérarchie minimale, où il y a beaucoup de place pour être ambitieux dans votre domaine d'expertise, ainsi que pour participer à la définition de notre équipe, notre culture et notre offre de produits.

  • Voyage d'équipe annuel d'une semaine avec un focus social et professionnel (payé - Nous sommes allés dans un château en Toscane, en Italie, en 2022 !)

  • Café, thé, boissons non alcoolisées, snacks, etc. jour et nuit

  • Espace de bureau magnifique avec accès 24/7

  • Salaire compétitif basé sur les qualifications et la performance

  • Culture de l'apprentissage et du développement

  • Événements sociaux et d'équipe mensuels

  • Progrès de carrière basé sur les mérites plutôt que sur l'ancienneté

  • Politique de vacances flexible

  • Assurance groupe

Et si vous pensez qu'il manque quelque chose, faites-le nous savoir. Nous pourrions probablement travailler ensemble pour l'ajouter. Après tout, nous essayons de créer le meilleur endroit possible pour travailler !

À propos de Signifly

Signifly est l'une des agences à la croissance la plus rapide au Danemark, et notre équipe jeune et dynamique a remporté plusieurs prix pour notre approche innovante des produits numériques et des expériences utilisateur. Nous sommes une équipe jeune et ambitieuse qui pousse constamment les limites de notre travail et de nos propres capacités.


Chez Signifly, nous collaborons avec une large gamme de clients de tous les secteurs pour créer de nouveaux produits numériques et modèles commerciaux innovants. Nous sommes une équipe de développeurs, de designers, de créatifs et de stratèges numériques, et nous croyons que la créativité, l'entrepreneuriat et un mélange diversifié de compétences de premier ordre peuvent stimuler l'innovation et le changement pour aider à façonner un avenir meilleur.


Appuyez sur le bouton de candidature et faites-nous part de vous et de votre emploi de rêve chez Signifly. Nous vous contacterons dès que possible. Nous accueillons les candidatures de toutes les personnes motivées, avec d'excellentes compétences en travail d'équipe, qui souhaitent aider à construire ce qui vient ensuite.


Nous avons hâte d'avoir de vos nouvelles !
